id./param/scenario/cs/b_150_cs_100.pack|cs_: "Is this the ore the former Luminary got...?
"{var:1}, this is amazing! This is orichalcum, the ancient divine metal in treasure legends everywhere!
"What, orichalcum! I've seen it in texts, but this ore is it?
"No mistake. Treasure's my specialty. Mia told me plenty about it as the world's rarest precious metal.
"...To think it's here. Forge this orichalcum and we can make an incredible sword!
"...I see! So that's the Sword of Light!
"That's one step closer to completing the new Sword of Light. Now, {var:1}, let's head to the next place."
